title: Red Hat Security Advisory: perl-DBI security update
description: A security vulnerability in the perl-DBI package for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support allows loading of arbitrary modules via unvalidated dbm_type and dbm_mldbm attributes in DBD::DBM. This issue is identified as CVE-2026-78030 and has been rated with an Important security impact by Red Hat. The vulnerability affects multiple architectures including x86_64, s390x, ppc64le, and aarch64. Red Hat has released updated packages to address this issue.
